summary: POET Technologies filed a Form 6-K reporting the closing of a US$400 million registered direct offering to a single institutional investor. The company issued 19,047,620 common shares and warrants for 19,047,620 shares at $21.00 per unit, a 2% premium to the $20.57 closing price. The warrants are exercisable at $26.25 for three years. Proceeds will fund manufacturing expansion, R&D, acquisitions, and working capital. The non-brokered structure avoided underwriting fees. Watch for dilution from warrant exercise and execution of the capacity scale-up plan.
